debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d t-o a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e l-o-g-i-n t-r-i-e-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-e-r-v-e-r l-o-g-s b-e-h-i-n-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-r-i-e-d t-o a-c-c-e-s-s g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e s-y-s-t-e-m-s, g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-n-g d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e q-u-e-r-i-e-s i-n t-h-e r-e-c-o-r-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e b-a-l-a-n-c-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-l-a-n-n-e-d t-o c-o-n-v-e-r-t f-u-n-d-s i-n-t-o c-a-s-h o-r g-o-o-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n t-r-a-c-e-s i-n t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e f-r-a-u-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-t-e-n-d-e-d t-o m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e p-u-r-c-h-a-s-i-n-g p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g u-n-u-s-u-a-l o-r-d-e-r m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r a-l-y-z-i-s c-o-n-t-r-o-l.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-e-r-g-e-d t-h-e s-t-e-p-s i-n-t-o o-n-e o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n a-i-m-e-d a-t a-c-c-o-u-n-t t-a-k-e-o-v-e-r, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-l-e-a-r a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l f-o-r i-n-v-e-s-t-i-g-a-t-o-r-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l s-i-g-n-o-f-f r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t.
